subject: Private environment fence + burst capacity at renewal — proposed topology and terms
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@biocrest.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procure@biocrest.com
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + isolation request — new private environment and burst nodes

Hi Markus,

Hope you're well — we are approaching our contract renewal window (Dec) and want to lock a plan for the private deployment expansion we discussed earlier. Two asks from our side: 

1) Separate analytics environment for PHI workloads (full tenant isolation / fenced VPC).
2) Ability to burst + reserve additional cluster capacity for EOD batch jobs (approx 200k tokens/day peak on 6 days/month).

Attached is an updated requirements sheet from our infra team (Biocrest_requirements_v2.xlsx) that lays out node counts and storage expectations. Key constraints: data must stay within us-east-1, and we need KMS integration with our HSM.

Can you confirm a proposed topology, how this impacts our renewal term/price, and an estimated timeline for provisioning? We need a procurement-ready line item to circulate.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Clarke
Head of Platform Engineering
Biocrest Therapeutics

Attachment: Biocrest_requirements_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 210KB)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@biocrest.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolation request — new private environment and burst nodes

Emma — thanks for the details and for the attachment. Initial read looks straightforward but there are a few items we'll need to align on before I send a procurement-ready quote: 

- Confirm peak concurrent RPS during bursts (helps size fronting autoscalers).
- Do you require a separate control-plane instance for the fenced VPC, or is a single multi-tenant control plane with strict RBAC + network enforcement acceptable?
- Is the 24-month renewal window acceptable if we price the added isolation as a term-based seat vs. one-time setup fee?

High-level proposal (draft):
- Add two isolated inference clusters (vpc-fence-a / vpc-fence-b) sized for 2x the steady-state tokens to allow for batching peaks.
- Reserve a burst pool (spot-backed + preemptible fallback) that can be scoped to 200k token/day peak; automatic fallback to lower-cost shared model if cluster saturated.
- 24-month term extension with split billing (base reserved + burst metered).

I'll loop in Karthik for SRE sizing and Olga for procurement/contracting impact. I'll also produce a PDF quote and a simple rollout schedule once we confirm the concurrency numbers.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

[Internal note: include platform SOW and KMS requirements in the quote]

From: Rajiv Sharma <rajiv.sharma@biocrest.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@biocrest.com>, procure@biocrest.com
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolation request — new private environment and burst nodes

Markus / team — quick answers from infra/procurement: 

- Peak concurrency: ~18 concurrent model sessions during bursts; sustained for ~4 hours on peak days.
- Control plane: procurement prefers single control plane with strict network enforcement (less operational overhead for us).
- Term: procurement has liberty to sign 24 months; finance will request a clause for a 90-day opt-out in case of M&A events.

I attached the updated requirements file (same v2) and a procurement checklist. Let me know if you need an internal PO number to include in the quote.

Rajiv
Senior Cloud Engineer, Biocrest

Attachment: Biocrest_requirements_v2.xlsx (updated)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Sharma <rajiv.sharma@biocrest.com>, Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@biocrest.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed topology, terms, and rollout — quote attached

Rajiv / Emma — appreciate the clarifications. Attached is a procurement-ready quote and a one-page rollout timeline (RI_Quote_Biocrest_20271124.pdf). Summary below: 

Summary (proposal):
- Isolation: Single Redwood control plane (hosted) + two fenced VPC environments in us-east-1. Network enforcement via dedicated egress ACLs and customer KMS/HSM integration.
- Capacity: Two isolated clusters sized at N1 (steady) + N1 (hot spare) + burst pool sized for 200k tokens/day; configured to autoscale based on concurrent sessions.
- Pricing: One-time setup fee: $45,000; Reserved capacity: $30,000/month; Burst usage: metered at $0.12 per 1k tokens above reserved baseline.
- Term: 24 months with a standard M&A opt-out clause (90 days notice) as requested.
- Timeline: Provisioning kickoff within 3 weeks of signed SOW; fenced VPCs ready in 6 weeks; testing + KMS integration in 8–10 weeks; production cutover in week 11.

Action items: 
1) Confirm PO number and billing contact — procurement.
2) Legal: accept the M&A opt-out clause or provide alternate language.
3) Approve the quote PDF so we can generate DocuSign.

Attachments: RI_Quote_Biocrest_20271124.pdf (quote, 120KB)

Thanks — will align with Olga on the contract redline window.

Best,
Markus
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_Quote_Biocrest_20271124.pdf
